name: Backed GOVIES 0-6 months EURO investment grade
oneLiner: bC3M is Backed's NAV-accreting tracker token for Amundi's short-dated Eurozone government bond UCITS ETF, KYC-gated and registered under Swiss DLT Act.
collateral: Tracker certificate fully backed by the AMUNDI ETF GOVIES 0-6 MONTHS EUROMTS INVESTMENT GRADE UCITS ETF, held in segregated custody and administered by Backed Assets (Jersey) Limited under Swiss DLT Act framework
pegMechanism: EUR-denominated NAV-accreting tracker token (not pegged to €1); price reflects the underlying short-term Eurozone government bond ETF NAV with continuous yield accrual; new issuance closed; KYC-gated redemption remains supported by Backed during the announced wind-down; secondary liquidity on Uniswap and CoW Protocol

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Backed identifies bC3M as an ERC-20 tracker certificate for the Amundi 0-6 month Eurozone government-bill ETF. Its value follows that short-duration sovereign-bill ETF rather than a fixed one-euro claim, so the existing tbill archetype is retained as the closest supported V9 category.

notices.title: Multi-chain Backed product
notices.message: bC3M is listed across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, BNB Chain, Polygon, Gnosis, and Fantom with the same token address. Pharos keeps those verified Backed deployments grouped under the native multichain product.

notices.title: New issuance closed; redemption supported
notices.message: Backed plans to wind down bTokens by the end of 2026. New bC3M issuance is closed; existing holders retain the standard redemption process during the wind-down. Backed lists TBLLx as the ETF upgrade destination, with the exchange ratio determined by the issuer.

notices.title: Coverage excludes unsold inventory
notices.message: The Polygon Chainlink LedgerLens feed reports underlying ETF shares. Pharos publishes coverage only when fresh on-chain supply minus two issuer-documented inventory wallets reconciles with Backed's circulating-supply API across all eight documented chains. The API has no observation timestamp of its own; any failed or mismatched read withholds the ratio.
